locator.section_heading: Fact sheet — AOE symptoms and modifying factors
locator.evidence_summary: Supports swimmer’s-ear terminology, water exposure, ear-canal inflammation, itching, fullness, hearing change, external-ear pain or tenderness, diabetes, immunocompromise, and tympanic-membrane context.

evidence.source_organisation: American Academy of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery Foundation
evidence.document_title: Updated Clinical Practice Guideline: Acute Otitis Externa — Official Fact Sheet and Key Action Statements
evidence.population_qualifier: People aged 2 years or older with diffuse acute otitis externa.
evidence.setting_qualifier: Primary, emergency, paediatric, internal-medicine, and otolaryngology settings.
evidence.evidence_summary: Supports swimmer’s-ear terminology, water exposure, ear-canal inflammation, itching, fullness, hearing change, external-ear pain or tenderness, diabetes, immunocompromise, and tympanic-membrane context.
evidence.applicability_note: Exact for diffuse acute otitis externa symptoms, modifiers, and key actions; partial for broad ear pain and not validated for UAE pathways.

locator.section_heading: Fact sheet — significant guideline action statements
locator.evidence_summary: Supports distinguishing AOE from other otalgia or otorrhoea, pain assessment, clinician-selected topical management, administration discussion, and reassessment after non-response.
